headline: Camden Property Trust (NYSE:CPT) Reports Mixed Q2 Results as Core FFO Meets Guidance and Portfolio Restructuring Advances
summary: Camden Property Trust Q2: Revenue and GAAP EPS miss estimates, but Core FFO meets guidance. Strategic California sale and improved leasing trends offset mixed results.
